title: Broker connection refused on malformed URL format
description: When the agent provided a malformed broker URL (double-wrapping the target URL), the broker returned a connection refused error instead of a validation error or helpful error message.
reproduction_steps: Attempt to make a proxied request with a malformed broker URL like `http://jentic-one:8100/http://test-api:8080/get`
Observe the connection refused error instead of a validation error
expected_behavior: The broker should validate the URL format and return a clear error message indicating the format is incorrect, or the CLI should validate and reject malformed URLs before sending them to the broker.
actual_behavior: The broker attempts to connect to the malformed URL and returns a generic connection refused error: 'dial tcp 172.28.0.5:8100: connect: connection refused'
evidence: Exit code 1: {"error": "Get \"http://jentic-one:8100/http://test-api:8080/get\": dial tcp 172.28.0.5:8100: connect: connection refused", "status": 0}
